summary.intent: Execute Phase 35 (Phala Testnet TEE Migration) end-to-end: restructure TEE worker into monorepo apps/, integrate shared packages, add Phala SDK, deploy to Phala Cloud CVM, verify, and ship a PR.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans completed across 4 waves, CVM deployed and verified on Phala Cloud production infrastructure, PR #395 opened, security review conducted with all high/medium findings resolved, lint fixed, merge conflicts resolved.

repo: TEE worker lives at apps/tee-worker/ (moved from root tee-worker/ in this phase)
Shared monorepo packages: @cipherbox/crypto (ECIES, clearBytes), @cipherbox/core (IPNS signing), @cipherbox/sdk-core (KuboProvider, PsaProvider)
multiformats is a dependency of @cipherbox/crypto but not tee-worker directly — must be added separately if used in tee-worker
Phala Cloud has no separate testnet — free tier ($20 credit) runs on same production nodes (Intel TDX hardware, dstack-pha-prod5.phala.network)
Phase name 35-phala-testnet-tee-migration is a misnomer — it's production Phala Cloud infrastructure
Docker host is at 192.168.133.12 (updated from stale 192.168.133.114 in memory)
Staging GitHub environment uses STAGING_TEE_WORKER_SECRET (not TEE_WORKER_SECRET) and PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY secrets
deploy-staging.yml has build-tee and deploy-tee-phala jobs — new staging-v* tag triggers full CVM rebuild and redeploy automatically
PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL is a GitHub staging variable (not secret) pointing to the live CVM endpoint
gsd-tools init must be run from the worktree directory, not the main repo, when using git worktrees

code.finding: Was calling getKeypair() instead of getPublicKey(), leaking private key into route scope — fixed to use getPublicKey()
Was reading TEE_EPOCH env var but migrate route uses TEE_CURRENT_EPOCH — inconsistency fixed to TEE_CURRENT_EPOCH
Added MAX_BATCH_SIZE=100 guard to prevent unbounded ECIES decryption DoS; removed dead keyEpoch field; derived successes/failures from results array instead of mutable counters
req.path on 404 fallback causes unbounded Prometheus label cardinality — fixed to use 'unmatched' constant

TOCTOU DNS rebinding vulnerability: DNS lookup was separate from HTTP fetch. Fixed by merging validateResolvedIp into ssrfSafeFetch — resolves IP, validates it, then connects directly with pinned IP and Host header. Headers API lowercases keys so host header must be lowercase 'host' not 'Host'

Hand-rolled CID regex replaced with CID.parse() from multiformats — handles all CID versions and multibase encodings correctly. Also accepts currentEpoch from request body instead of reading stale env var at module load
Tests for ssrfSafeFetch needed dns/promises mock after DNS pinning was added — TEE_MODE=production tests now mock dns.lookup
Had a require() import that failed ESLint @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports — must use ES import syntax

workflow: Parallel agent worktrees can cause git config lock conflicts — run wave 2+ plans sequentially if wave 1 had lock issues
Agent worktrees need explicit merge + cleanup after each wave; STATE.md conflicts should take the agent's version
Pause/resume workflow (gsd:pause-work + gsd:resume-work) works well for transferring session context across machines — HANDOFF.json carries credentials, remaining tasks, and mental model
Secrets shared in conversation appear in entire/* branch checkpoints — rotate immediately after any session where credentials were pasted or generated
gh secret set --env staging is the correct command for environment-scoped secrets; gh variable set --env staging for non-secret config
gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/environments/{env}/secrets can verify secret update timestamps to confirm rotation
Security review should be done before PR creation, not after — found critical public-key route bug (private key exposure) post-execution
classifyHandoffIfNeeded error from Claude Code runtime is a false failure — spot-check SUMMARY.md and git commits to confirm actual success

friction: Usage limit hit mid-wave-2 execution, requiring manual continuation and sequential re-execution of both wave 2 plans
git config lock conflicts prevented parallel worktree execution for wave 2 — had to fall back to sequential
gsd-tools init returns phase_found:false when run from main repo instead of worktree — not obvious error
STATE.md merge conflicts on every agent worktree merge required manual conflict resolution
CVM took ~90 seconds to restart and health endpoint returned empty reply during boot — required multiple retry loops
Phala CLI phala restart command syntax unclear — had to check help before use
Docker not available on dev machine (runs on separate Docker host 192.168.133.12) — required session transfer workflow
multiformats not in tee-worker package.json despite being available via @cipherbox/crypto — caused type-check failure after CID.parse() refactor
Headers API silently lowercases all header names — caused two test failures after SSRF DNS pinning refactor
Copilot review comments not accessible via GitHub API — could not programmatically reply to review thread
Secrets (Phala API key, TEE worker secret) were committed to HANDOFF.json and .continue-here.md in git history — required rotation
open_items: SSRF probe deduplication: connection-test.ts has similar connectivity probe logic to sdk-core — deferred as significant refactor
Phala Cloud CVM latency is ~1155ms avg (network-bound to cloud) — production co-location with API expected to reduce significantly, but not yet measured
35-HUMAN-UAT.md persists with status:partial — needs resolution via /gsd:verify-work once CVM health and GitHub env are confirmed stable
Phase name (35-phala-testnet-tee-migration) is technically inaccurate but kept to avoid breaking cross-references — directory rename deferred
Old Phala API key and TEE worker secret remain in git history on phase-35 branch (commits 607c50fec, bd265fa4f) and entire/* transcript — harmless now that rotated but not purged
PR #395 open but not yet merged — pending CI passes after lint fix
